notesZh: 皮肤与设置合并为紧凑窗口，皮肤商店支持直接在当前时钟或倒计时上免费预览；改进数字居中、边缘控制按钮和模式切换。修复 ZIP 版四款单品皮肤的激活 / 恢复入口。请退出旧版，从官方 itch.io 页面下载并完整解压新 ZIP 后运行。免费本体和已验证皮肤授权保持。
notesEn: Skins and settings now share a compact window, with free skin previews on the current clock or countdown. Improves digit alignment, edge controls and mode switching. Restores the Activate / Restore action for all four individual itch.io skins in the ZIP edition. Exit the old app, download from the official itch.io page and extract the complete new ZIP before running. The free core and verified skin licenses are preserved.
